messages:
jules: onboarding vortex11b-int4 on canary, seeing OOMs during multi-turns. defaults: max_new_tokens=512, batching.max_batch_tokens=12288. mem_frag jumps ~0.8 before crash. any fast mitigations?

li: can you paste the quick crash profile? curious about transient allocs and prefetch state.

jules: dump from host-7:
```
GPU0 total=24576MB used=15012MB peak=15300MB
OOM at token_idx=489
mem_frag_ratio=0.80
transient_alloc_bytes=340MB
kv_prefetch=true
```

marc: pattern familiar for int4. prefetched KV + kernel temporaries cause many small freelists that block compaction. quick hedges: reduce max_new_tokens, lower batch token cap, set prefetch adaptive, and enable slot_compactor.runoff. also cap per-request kernel scratch to 200MB. CLI I used: 
```
redwood canary deploy --model vortex11b-int4 \
  --max_new_tokens 192 \
  --batching.max_batch_tokens 6144 \
  --batching.max_batch_size 6 \
  --runtime.kv.prefetch adaptive \
  --runtime.slot_compactor.runoff true \
  --runtime.kernel.scratch_cap_mb 200
```

jules: applying on canary-2 now. thanks.

li: quick microbench (600 warm + 1800 measured):
- before: p50=98ms p95=410ms avg GPU mem=14.9GB OOMs=1.2%
- after: p50=110ms p95=220ms avg GPU mem=12.3GB OOMs=0.0%
quality eval (180 prompts): rouge-L delta -0.8% (within threshold).

marc: nice. please open GH issue to track kernel scratch hard cap + allocator compaction improvements. i'll propose a short-term default for int4 models: max_new_tokens=192, batching.max_batch_tokens=6144.

ops-bot: canary deploy v0.8.1 for vortex11b-int4 started on 3 hosts  2/3 succeeded so far. logs: https://ci.redwood/canaries/3685123456

jules: plan: keep canary live 6h, run full eval suite. if regressions <=2% and no OOMs we'll promote and update onboarding doc and recommended defaults. archiving logs under /ml/onboard/vortex11b/int4/3685123456. ping @marc if any spike. :thumbsup:
